title: The Lookout Café
summary: A gorge-side restaurant associated with the Wild Horizons high-wire activity site.
body: The Lookout Café combines dining with a position above the Batoka Gorge. It is also the location associated with Wild Horizons’ high-wire activities, so lunch can be considered alongside a gorge outing.
A restaurant table and an activity booking are separate arrangements unless a package explicitly combines them. Confirm your preferred meal time and any seating requests directly with the venue.

planning.label: Reserve
planning.text: Ask about current service times and the availability of your preferred seating.

planning.label: Combine with an activity
planning.text: Leave enough time for the activity briefing and any weather-related changes.

planning.label: Dietary & access needs
planning.text: Discuss allergies and access requirements with the restaurant when reserving.

sources.title: The Lookout Café · Official venue information

title: Baines Restaurant
summary: A restaurant on the banks of the Zambezi upstream of Victoria Falls.
body: Baines is positioned beside the Zambezi on Zambezi Drive. Its river setting is the main reason to consider it for a longer lunch or a meal around the end of the day.
Check the current menu and reservation arrangements before planning a special occasion. A riverside table or a particular outlook should be requested rather than assumed.

planning.label: Seating
planning.text: Ask about indoor and outdoor seating and weather arrangements.

planning.label: Getting there
planning.text: Arrange the journey and return transfer from your accommodation.

planning.label: Reservation
planning.text: Confirm the meal time, current menu and any dietary requirements.

title: Stanley’s Terrace
atmosphere: A hotel terrace with bridge views
summary: Afternoon tea and light meals on the terrace at The Victoria Falls Hotel.
body: Stanley’s Terrace offers afternoon tea and light meals with views towards Victoria Falls Bridge and the waterfall’s spray. It is a dining venue within The Victoria Falls Hotel, rather than a separate accommodation listing.
The hotel specifically asks non-resident visitors to pre-book. If afternoon tea is the reason for your visit, confirm the current serving window and table arrangements before travelling.

planning.label: Non-resident visits
planning.text: Pre-book with the hotel’s food and beverage team.

planning.label: High tea
planning.text: Confirm the current tea service, menu and any dietary adaptations.

planning.label: Setting
planning.text: Request your preferred seating and ask about access through the hotel.

sources.title: The Victoria Falls Hotel · Stanley’s Terrace

title: MaKuwa-Kuwa Restaurant
atmosphere: Lodge dining with a waterhole setting
summary: Dining at Victoria Falls Safari Lodge, overlooking its bush and waterhole setting.
body: MaKuwa-Kuwa is the main restaurant at Victoria Falls Safari Lodge. Its lodge setting offers a different atmosphere from the restaurants in the town centre.
A meal can be considered alongside a visit to the estate, but restaurant bookings, Vulture Culture access and transfers should each be checked. This is not the similarly named airport lounge.

planning.label: Book a table
planning.text: Confirm access for non-resident diners and the current meal services.

planning.label: Your visit
planning.text: Ask about the outlook from your table if the waterhole setting matters to you.

planning.label: Plan the journey
planning.text: Arrange transport and check any separate estate experience in advance.

title: The Three Monkeys
summary: A town-centre restaurant and bar for a meal between outings or an evening with friends.
body: The Three Monkeys has operated in Victoria Falls since 2016. It offers a restaurant-and-bar setting in town, making it a practical option to consider around a day of sightseeing.
Check the current menu and make a reservation for a larger group or a fixed evening plan. Do not rely on a search-result price range as a substitute for the venue’s own menu.

planning.label: Your table
planning.text: Ask about group seating and whether a reservation is advisable for your chosen time.

planning.label: Menu
planning.text: Check the current food, drinks and dietary options directly with the venue.

planning.label: Getting back
planning.text: Arrange your return to your accommodation after dinner.

alt: The Three Monkeys · official venue photograph

title: Cassia Restaurant
summary: Indoor and outdoor dining in the gardens of Ilala Lodge Hotel.
body: Cassia is the restaurant at Ilala Lodge Hotel, with indoor and outdoor dining and a wine list. The hotel describes breakfast, lunch and dinner services, with lighter options around the poolside setting.

It is worth considering when you want a hotel restaurant rather than a busy bar environment. Check the current service and menu with the restaurant, particularly for a special occasion or non-resident visit.

planning.label: Choose the service
planning.text: Confirm whether you are reserving breakfast, lunch or dinner.

planning.label: Seating
planning.text: Ask about terrace or indoor availability and the arrangements for rain.

planning.label: Dietary needs
planning.text: Provide allergy and dietary information when you book.

title: GOAT at Mama Africa
summary: An African-inspired town eatery at Mama Africa, with a live-music programme to check when booking.
body: GOAT at Mama Africa combines African and Western dishes with a setting that celebrates the Zambezi’s rafting and kayaking history. The venue describes music as part of its evening offering.

The programme can change, so ask which nights currently include live performance. A table reservation and the current menu are more useful planning information than an old review score or a copied price range.

planning.label: Music
planning.text: Confirm the performance programme for the night you want to visit.

planning.label: Menu
planning.text: Ask about current dishes and any allergy or dietary requirements.

planning.label: Groups
planning.text: Check seating arrangements and advance reservation requirements.

alt: GOAT at Mama Africa · official venue photograph

title: River Brewing Co & The Smokehouse
atmosphere: Beer, grilled food & a sociable evening
summary: The River’s beer and The Smokehouse’s food brought together at one Victoria Falls venue.
body: River Brewing Co describes The Smokehouse as its dining partner, pairing its beers with flame-grilled dishes. Treat them as associated offerings at the same venue rather than two unrelated stops.
The venue also promotes a music programme, with the atmosphere changing between daytime dining and evenings. Check what is scheduled on your chosen date and reserve if you are visiting with a group.

planning.label: Where to go
planning.text: Use the current venue address on Adam Stander Drive and confirm your reservation contact.

planning.label: Evening programme
planning.text: Ask about live music or events rather than assuming a performance every night.

planning.label: Your visit
planning.text: Check food service times and arrange transport back to your accommodation.
